title: Understanding the Residual
text: The residual is the difference between the actual value and the predicted value. In this case, you need to find out how many sols the model predicts for a mission with $$20$$ food portions and $$3$$ astronauts, and then compare it to the actual duration of $$5$$ sols.

title: Calculating the Predicted Value
text: To find the predicted value, use the weight vector $$\([-3, 0.25, 2]\)$$ and the features \([1,20,3]\). The first element in the feature vector is always $$1$$ for the intercept. Calculate the dot product of these two vectors.

title: Dot Product Calculation
text: What is the result of the dot product $$\([-3, 0.25, 2]\)$$ and \([1,20,3]\)?

title: Finding the Residual
text: Now that you have the predicted value, subtract it from the actual value of $$5$$ sols to find the residual.
